summary: A one-column, night-mode launch page for a two-style display face (Black and Outline), built on Lost Type's React specimen template: every display line is an editable field that auto-scales to fill the column, and a pill button flips whole sections between the two styles. A long first-person designer essay with diagrams leads into a grey licensing and about section.

instances.look: Centred white ultra-heavy caps on black: 'INTRODUCING / →FACTION← / A NEW DISPLAY TYPEFACE FROM LOST TYPE', the name and arrows in the Outline style, then a small credit line and an outlined pill 'Get Faction'
instances.feel: Loud, poster-like, like a gig flyer
instances.ux: Lines flicker on one after another at load; a single 'Get Faction' link to the Lost Type shop; a round day/night mode switch sits in the top-right corner
instances.learn: Let the launch announcement itself be the specimen, and set only the family name in the second style so both styles appear in the first line you read

reconstruction.layout: Centred header, max-width 1280px, ~930px tall (≈1 viewport); five display lines at line-height 1, then credit line and pill button ~40px apart; day/night toggle (10vw square, max 100px) absolute top-right
reconstruction.typography: Display lines 140px LT Faction Black, uppercase, line-height 1.0; '→FACTION←' in LT Faction Outline with the arrows as glyphs (aria-hidden); credit 'Designed by Shiva Nallaperumal' ~24px LT Tofino Wide; button label ~16px Tofino Wide
reconstruction.behaviour: On load each line runs a 'vhs-flicker' keyframe (opacity flicker) with delays 0s, 0.25s, 0.5s, so the headline stutters on like a bad VHS tape; afterwards static. The corner button toggles the whole page between night (black) and day (inverted) mode; images carry an is-day--invert class
reconstruction.assets: none (sun/moon toggle is an inline SVG)
reconstruction.html: header > h1 (div.vhs-flicker × 2 with animation-delay) + span.vhs-flicker + credit + a.button[href=losttype.com/font/?name=faction]; button[aria-label='Switch to Day Mode'] in the corner; root has class is-night

instances.variantDefinition: Editable display lines that each rescale their font size to fill the column width as you type; no size or axis controls, at most one button that switches the style of the whole stack.
instances.look: Seven white lines each filling the column at ~190px ('BLACK FLAG', 'Revolution!', '“Machine”', '@tweeters', 'ÆSKUÁR 23', '₹2,93,8415', '©Copyright') under an outlined pill button labelled 'Outline'

instances.learn: Auto-fitting each editable line to the measure keeps a display tester looking like a poster whatever the visitor types; choose default words that smuggle in the awkward glyphs (Æ, Á, ₹, ©, @, curly quotes)

reconstruction.behaviour: On input, measure the line's natural width and set font-size = column width / text width × current size (white-space: nowrap); the button toggles a family class on the wrapper (Black ⇄ Outline) and swaps its own label and fill (black fill with white border vs white fill)
